notes.subject: feat(tools): fit masked image edits to the target size and keep unmasked pixels
notes.summary: Masked image edits from generate_image are now resized to the edit target and keep original pixels outside the mask, with a new mask_composite option and provider_size reporting.

notes.subject: fix(tools): let Generate for Session cover image edits and masks
notes.summary: Generate for Session approval now also covers image edits, masks and ordinary quality/size options, while xhigh/max quality and sizes above 2560x1440 still need per-call approval.
